description.short_caption: Erythematous nodules and ulcers on the forearm.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the forearm of an elderly individual with multiple erythematous nodules and ulcers. Some lesions appear raised and inflamed, with one showing a central crust or scab. The lesions are distributed along the extensor surface of the forearm. The surrounding skin shows mild erythema but no significant swelling or discharge is visible.

description.short_caption: Forearm with erythematous nodules and ulcerations, suggestive of cutaneous infection.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the forearm of a patient with multiple erythematous nodules and ulcerations distributed along the skin. Some lesions appear raised and inflamed, while others show signs of crusting or breakdown. The pattern suggests a possible infectious process, such as sporotrichosis or another cutaneous infection. The patient is wearing a hospital gown, indicating a clinical setting.
